findings.issue: Common noun H7676 is dumped untranslated as shabat.
Common noun H7677 is dumped untranslated as shabatón.
Hophal imperfect 3ms (he is put to death) is rendered as active morirá, changing stem force.
Unmarked supplied preposition de stands before the qal infinitive absolute.
Niphal 3ms imperfect is smoothed to feminine será hecha to agree with obra.
Definite qal participle (the one doing) is smoothed as el haciendo; the doer remains the subject.

notes: Construct de, articles, Jehová, and the verbless holiness clause match the tokens.
